pass19__wanderer_survive.name: WANDERER

Grey exposed bare human torso with black crystalline deposits at shoulders/forearms. Head entirely replaced/covered by irregular black crystal cluster with ONE long angled red translucent pointed crystal. No visible regular human face, eyes or hair. Black charcoal straight trousers, black belt and plain dark shoes. Exactly two bare humanoid arms and two legs. Match slender ordinary human body proportions from licensed sculpture; no stylised demon armour.

pass19__mortar_survive.name: MORTAR
pass19__mortar_survive.anatomicalSides: Original2018 Mortar creature. Very bulky charcoal-black glossy irregular crystalline covering on head, chest, shoulders and ONE huge organic cannon arm. Red pointed head crystal. One ordinary small grey humanoid opposite hand/arm; dark loose trousers and ordinary heavy dark feet. No human face, no carried gun or military artillery machine. Preserve anatomical RIGHT massive crystal cannon arm visible on VIEWER LEFT in original front-facing screenshot; other ordinary arm is anatomical LEFT. Do not mirror arm assignment between facing atlases. The original screenshot is dark; tiny crystalline topology/unlit clothing is not independently certified.
pass19__mortar_survive.sourceScope: Original screenshot is visual authority for enlarged cannon arm; community text differs on arm naming, so right-arm assignment is an observed front-body reading requiring review, not certified exact model topology.
